ja.B: そこでペトロは十一人と共に立ち上がり、声を張り上げて人々に語り出した。「{{gender:ユダヤの人たち|ユダヤの男たち}}、またエルサレムに住むすべての皆さん、このことを知っていただきたい。わたしの言葉によく耳を傾けてください。
ja.R: そこでペトロは、ほかの十一人の使徒たちと一緒に立ち上がり、みんなに聞こえるように大きな声で話しました。「ユダヤのみなさん、エルサレムに住んでいるすべてのみなさん、聞いてください。これがどういうことなのか、お話しします。わたしの言うことを、よく聞いてください。

decisions.choice: spoke out: the same verb as in 2:4, of speaking moved by the Spirit
decisions.reason: Peter speaks out as the Spirit gave the others to speak out (2:4). The word is used of serious, inspired speech.

decisions.choice: men, Jews: a formal address to the crowd
decisions.reason: Speeches in Acts open this way (1:16, 2:22). As in 2:5, it is likely the whole crowd that is addressed.

decisions.choice: the eleven: the other apostles, Matthias now among them
decisions.reason: With Peter they make twelve (1:26).

decisions.choice: Jewish people, with "Jewish men" as the alternative; Literal keeps "men, Jews"
decisions.reason: The inclusive default follows the meaning note.

decisions.choice: I will tell you what this means
alternatives: let this be known to you
decisions.reason: Readable says what Peter is about to make known.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Juifs|Hommes juifs}}
decisions.reason: French "Juifs", in the plural, takes in the whole crowd, men and women, so it is the inclusive default without an added word; "Hommes juifs" keeps the Greek "men" as the alternative. Literal keeps "Hommes, Juifs".

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:presten|prestad}}, {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}}, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} and every plural you through 2:40
decisions.reason: Peter speaks to the crowd until 2:40, so every plural "you", pronoun or verb, is the plural_you setting: the ustedes form by default, the vosotros form as the alternative.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Judíos|Hombres judíos}}
decisions.reason: As in 3:12: the address takes in the whole crowd, so the default names them all, with the traditional "Hombres judíos" as the alternative; Literal keeps "Hombres judíos".

decisions.choice: Wanaume, Wayahudi (L); Enyi Wayahudi (B); ninyi Wayahudi wote (R), no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on "Wayahudi" like the English Jewish people / Jewish men
decisions.reason: The address takes in the whole crowd (meaning decision on "men, Jews"). "Wayahudi" already names men and women, and the only traditional alternative, "wanaume" (males), would narrow the meaning, so Balanced has no gender span; Literal keeps both Greek words, as in 3:12.

decisions.choice: akawatamkia
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 2:4 for speaking moved by the Spirit (meaning decision on "spoke out"); Literal uses "kutamka" in both places to keep the link.

decisions.choice: "Thưa các ông người Do Thái" (L); "Thưa {{gender:đồng bào Do Thái|các ông người Do Thái}}" (B); "Thưa đồng bào Do Thái" (R)
decisions.reason: A formal address to the crowd (meaning decision). "đồng bào", "fellow countrymen", is the Vietnamese way a speaker addresses his own people and includes women; the English sets "Jewish people" against "Jewish men" at Balanced, and so does the Vietnamese. Literal keeps the word for men.

decisions.choice: Peter says "tôi" for himself, "chúng tôi" for the apostles, "chúng ta" where his hearers are included, and "anh em" for the crowd he speaks to (2:14-40; also 3:12-26)
decisions.reason: "anh em" is the ordinary Vietnamese "you" for a speaker addressing a crowd of his own people, and fits both forms of the address. It is not under the gender setting, which is kept for the formal address.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks to the crowd in 합쇼체 and says "나"; "유대 사람 여러분" at every level, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span giving "유대 남자" as the alternative (B)
decisions.reason: As in 1:16, "여러분" is the formal address to a gathering and "men" is not said separately. Korean "사람" includes women and men, so the English span has nothing to change. "열한 [사도]" (L) as the Korean Luke 24:9 supplies "[제자]" after the bare number.

decisions.choice: "힘 있게 말했다" (L), "외쳤다" (B) for apophthengomai
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 2:4, of speaking moved by the Spirit (meaning decision); Korean marks that it was no ordinary speaking.

decisions.choice: Judeus, with "Homens judeus" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The masculine plural "judeus" takes in men and women in Portuguese, so the inclusive default simply leaves out "homens", as the English default says "Jewish people". Apostles speak to the crowd with "vocês".

decisions.choice: "እናንተ አይሁድ" (you Jews, B, R) with no gender span; "የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ" in 2:22 likewise; Literal keeps "ሰዎች" (men) here
decisions.reason: "አይሁድ" and "ሰዎች" already include men and women, so Amharic needs no setting where the English Balanced has one; a form with "ወንዶች" (males) would not be the traditional Amharic either.

decisions.choice: Peter says "आप" to the crowd
decisions.reason: A public speech to a gathered people is made with "आप" in Hindi (style guide, section 4: the address the scene calls for). The apostles' speeches to crowds and to the Council in Acts take "आप" throughout, even where they accuse their hearers, so the relationship does not change between verses.

decisions.choice: "हे यहूदी लोगो", with "हे यहूदी पुरुषो" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The style guide's span for andres meaning people in general (section 7), as the English has it; Literal keeps "पुरुषो".

decisions.choice: Мужи иудеи (L); Иудеи, with "Мужи иудейские" as the alternative (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the formal "men, Jews"; Balanced makes the inclusive address the default, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ユダヤの人たち" (L); "{{gender:ユダヤの人たち|ユダヤの男たち}}" (B); "ユダヤのみなさん" (R)
alternatives: "男たち、ユダヤ人たち" at Literal
decisions.reason: The formal address "men, Jews" likely means the whole crowd (m2). Japanese "人たち" is already inclusive, so Literal and Readable need no span; Balanced keeps the span the English has, with "男たち" as the alternative. The same holds for "men of Israel" in 2:22.

decisions.choice: "語り出した", the same verb as in 2:4
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the verb of 2:4 for Peter's Spirit-moved speech (m1); Japanese repeats "語り出す" so the link is heard.

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ὡς ὑμεῖς ὑπολαμβάνετε οὗτοι μεθύουσιν, ἔστιν γὰρ ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας, ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ εἰρημένον διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἰωήλ·

records.literal_gloss: Not for as you suppose these are drunk, it is for [the] hour third of the day, \v 16 but this is the [thing] spoken through the prophet Joel:

en.L: For these are not drunk, as you suppose, for it is [the] third hour of the day; \v 16 but this is what was spoken through the prophet Joel:
en.B: They are not drunk, as you imagine. The day is only three hours old; it is nine in the morning. \v 16 No, this is what was spoken through the prophet Joel:
en.R: You think these people are drunk, but they are not. It is too early for that; it is only nine o'clock in the morning. \v 16 No, this is what the prophet Joel spoke about:

fr.L: Car ceux-ci ne sont pas ivres, comme vous le supposez, car c’est la troisième heure du jour ; \v 16 mais c’est ce qui a été dit par le prophète Joël :
fr.B: Ces gens ne sont pas ivres, comme vous l’imaginez. Le jour n’a que trois heures : il est neuf heures du matin. \v 16 Non, c’est ce que le prophète Joël a annoncé :
fr.R: Vous pensez que ces gens sont ivres, mais ils ne le sont pas. Il est trop tôt pour cela : il n’est que neuf heures du matin. \v 16 Non, c’est ce dont le prophète Joël a parlé :

sw.L: Kwa maana hawa hawajalewa, kama mnavyodhani, kwa kuwa ni saa tatu ya siku; \v 16 bali hili ndilo lililonenwa kupitia nabii Yoeli:
sw.B: Watu hawa hawajalewa kama mnavyodhani. Ni saa tatu asubuhi tu. \v 16 Hapana, hili ndilo lililonenwa kupitia nabii Yoeli:
sw.R: Mnadhani watu hawa wamelewa, lakini hawajalewa. Ni mapema mno kwa hilo; sasa ni saa tatu asubuhi tu. \v 16 Hapana, hili ndilo jambo ambalo nabii Yoeli alilizungumzia:

es.L: Porque estos no están borrachos, como {{plural_you:ustedes suponen|vosotros suponéis}}, pues es [la] hora tercera del día; \v 16 sino que esto es lo dicho por medio del profeta Joel:
es.B: Estos no están borrachos, como {{plural_you:ustedes piensan|vosotros pensáis}}. El día apenas comienza: son las nueve de la mañana. \v 16 No, esto es lo que se dijo por medio del profeta Joel:
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes piensan|Vosotros pensáis}} que estos están borrachos, pero no lo están. Es demasiado temprano para eso; apenas son las nueve de la mañana. \v 16 No, esto es lo que anunció el profeta Joel:

vi.L: Vì những người này không say như anh em nghĩ đâu, vì bây giờ mới là giờ thứ ba trong ngày; \v 16 nhưng đây là điều đã được nói qua nhà tiên tri Giô-ên:
vi.B: Những người này không say như anh em tưởng. Bây giờ mới chín giờ sáng. \v 16 Không, đây chính là điều đã được nói qua nhà tiên tri Giô-ên:
vi.R: Anh em nghĩ những người này say rượu, nhưng họ không say đâu. Bây giờ còn quá sớm để say; mới chín giờ sáng thôi. \v 16 Không phải vậy, đây là điều nhà tiên tri Giô-ên đã nói đến:

ko.L: 여러분이 짐작하는 것처럼 이 사람들이 취한 것이 아닙니다. 지금은 낮 제삼시[이기] 때문입니다. \v 16 오히려 이것은 예언자 요엘을 통하여 말씀하신 것입니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 생각하는 것처럼 이 사람들은 취한 것이 아닙니다. 지금은 겨우 아침 아홉 시입니다. \v 16 이것은 바로 예언자 요엘을 통하여 하나님께서 말씀하신 일입니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 이 사람들이 술에 취했다고 생각하지만, 그렇지 않습니다. 지금은 아침 아홉 시밖에 되지 않았습니다. \v 16 이 일은 오래전에 예언자 요엘이 말한 일입니다.

pt.L: Porque estes não estão bêbados, como vocês pensam, pois é a hora terceira do dia; \v 16 mas isto é o que foi dito por meio do profeta Joel:
pt.B: Eles não estão bêbados, como vocês imaginam. O dia começou há apenas três horas; são nove da manhã. \v 16 Não, isto é o que foi dito por meio do profeta Joel:
pt.R: Vocês pensam que estas pessoas estão bêbadas, mas não estão. É cedo demais para isso; são só nove horas da manhã. \v 16 Não, isto é o que o profeta Joel anunciou:

am.L: እናንተ እንደምትገምቱት እነዚህ የሰከሩ አይደሉምና፤ የቀኑ ሦስተኛ ሰዓት ነውና፤ \v 16 ነገር ግን ይህ በነቢዩ በኢዩኤል የተነገረው ነው፦
am.B: እናንተ እንደምታስቡት እነዚህ ሰዎች አልሰከሩም፤ ገና ከጠዋቱ ሦስት ሰዓት ነው። \v 16 ይልቁንም ይህ በነቢዩ በኢዩኤል የተነገረው ነው፦
am.R: እነዚህ ሰዎች የሰከሩ ይመስላችኋል፤ ግን አልሰከሩም። ለዚህ ገና ጠዋት ነው፤ ሰዓቱ ገና ከጠዋቱ ሦስት ሰዓት ነው። \v 16 ይልቁንም ይህ ነቢዩ ኢዩኤል የተናገረለት ነገር ነው፦

hi.L: क्योंकि ये नशे में नहीं हैं, जैसा आप समझते हैं, क्योंकि अभी दिन का तीसरा घंटा ही है; \v 16 पर यह वह बात है जो योएल भविष्यद्वक्ता के द्वारा कही गई थी:
hi.B: जैसा आप सोच रहे हैं, ये नशे में नहीं हैं। अभी दिन के तीन ही घंटे बीते हैं; सुबह के नौ बजे हैं। \v 16 नहीं, यह वही है जो योएल भविष्यद्वक्ता के द्वारा कहा गया था:
hi.R: आप सोचते हैं कि ये लोग नशे में हैं, पर ऐसा नहीं है। अभी तो सुबह के सिर्फ़ नौ बजे हैं, नशे का समय नहीं। \v 16 नहीं, यह वही बात है जिसके बारे में योएल नबी ने कहा था:

ru.L: Ведь не пьяны они, как вы предполагаете, ведь сейчас третий час дня, \v 16 но это есть сказанное через пророка Иоиля:
ru.B: Они не пьяны, как вы думаете: ведь сейчас только третий час дня, девять утра. \v 16 Нет, это то, о чём было сказано через пророка Иоиля:
ru.R: Вы думаете, что эти люди пьяны, но это не так. Ещё слишком рано, сейчас только девять часов утра. \v 16 Нет, это то, о чём говорил пророк Иоиль:

uk.L: Бо ці не пʼяні, як ви гадаєте, бо [тепер] третя година дня; \v 16 але це те, що було сказано через пророка Йоіла:
uk.B: Вони не пʼяні, як вам здається. Від початку дня минуло лише три години: тепер девʼята ранку. \v 16 Ні, це те, що було сказано через пророка Йоіла:
uk.R: Ви думаєте, що ці люди пʼяні, але це не так. Для цього ще надто рано: зараз тільки девʼята ранку. \v 16 Ні, це те, про що говорив пророк Йоіл:

ja.L: あなたがたが思っているように、この人たちが酔っているのではありません。今は昼の第三の時だからです。\v 16 そうではなく、これは預言者ヨエルを通して言われていたことなのです。
ja.B: この人たちは、あなたがたが考えているように酒に酔っているのではありません。まだ第三の時、午前九時ごろなのですから。\v 16 そうではなく、これこそ、預言者ヨエルによって語られていたことなのです。
ja.R: みなさんは、この人たちが酔っていると思っていますが、そうではありません。酔うにはまだ早すぎます。今はまだ午前九時ごろです。\v 16 これは、預言者ヨエルが前もって語っていたことなのです。

decisions.choice: the third hour of the day: about nine in the morning
decisions.reason: The hours of the day were counted from sunrise, about six o'clock. It was far too early in the day for a crowd to be drunk.

decisions.choice: this is what Joel spoke of: what they see is the fulfillment of his words
alternatives: this is like what Joel said
decisions.reason: "This is that" identifies the event with the prophecy. The quotation follows in 2:17-21.

decisions.choice: nine in the morning
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the clock time a modern reader understands. Balanced keeps the count of hours too.

decisions.choice: la hora tercera (L); las nueve de la mañana (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:1: the hours were counted from sunrise, so the third hour is about nine in the morning; Literal keeps the Greek count.

decisions.choice: saa tatu (L); saa tatu asubuhi (B, R)
alternatives: "saa tisa", the European clock hour, which a Swahili reader would take as three in the afternoon
decisions.reason: Swahili counts the hours from sunrise as the Greek does, so the third hour of the day (meaning decision on the third hour) is simply "saa tatu", with no conversion, where the English says "nine in the morning". Balanced and Readable add "asubuhi" (in the morning).

decisions.choice: "giờ thứ ba" (L); "chín giờ sáng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide says, Literal keeps the Greek count and the other levels give the modern time.

decisions.choice: "낮 제삼시" (L); "아침 아홉 시" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek count of hours, Balanced and Readable give the modern time (style guide, section 5), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "말씀하신 것" (L), "하나님께서 말씀하신 일" (B) for the passive "what was spoken"
decisions.reason: The Greek passive means God spoke through the prophet; Korean marks this with the honorific, and Balanced names God, where Readable follows the English in naming Joel.

decisions.choice: "ከጠዋቱ ሦስት ሰዓት" (three in the morning by Ethiopian reckoning, B, R); "የቀኑ ሦስተኛ ሰዓት" (the third hour of the day, L)
alternatives: "ከጠዋቱ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት" (nine in the morning, Western reckoning)
decisions.reason: Ethiopians count the hours from dawn, as the Greek does, so the Greek third hour is three o'clock in Ethiopian time, about nine in the morning in Western time.

decisions.choice: "दिन का तीसरा घंटा" (L); "सुबह के नौ बजे" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's rule for clock time (section 5): Literal keeps the Greek count, Balanced and Readable give the hour as a modern reader counts it; Balanced keeps the count of hours too.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B); "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for prophet, with the everyday word at Readable.

decisions.choice: третий час дня (L); третий час дня, девять утра (B); девять часов утра (R)
decisions.reason: As settled for the book: Literal keeps the Greek count, Balanced and Readable give the time as a modern reader counts it.

decisions.choice: "девʼята ранку"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the hour as a modern reader counts it.

decisions.choice: "昼の第三の時" (L); "第三の時、午前九時ごろ" (B); "午前九時ごろ" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek count of hours from sunrise; Balanced keeps the count and gives the modern time, and Readable gives the modern time only, as the meaning note (m1) explains. Hours in Acts are given as "午前/午後○時ごろ" at Balanced and Readable (3:1, 10:3, 23:23).

decisions.choice: "みなさん" in the apostles' polite speeches, "あなたたち" in plain speech and in quoted Scripture, for plural "you" (R)
decisions.reason: The Japanese style guide gives "あなたがた" for plural "you" at Literal and Balanced and "あなたたち" or "みなさん" at Readable. Acts Readable uses "みなさん", written in kana as in the letters, where the speaker addresses an audience politely, and "あなたたち" where the speech is plain (Jesus, Gallio, Festus) and in Scripture quoted in 『』.

source.text: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις, λέγει ὁ θεός, ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ὑμῶν ὁράσεις ὄψονται, καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ὑμῶν ἐνυπνίοις ἐνυπνιασθήσονται·

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in the last days, says the God, I will pour out from the Spirit of me upon all flesh, and will prophesy the sons of you and the daughters of you, and the young men of you visions will see, and the old men of you dreams will dream.

en.L: 'And it will be in the last days, says God, [that] I will pour out from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters will prophesy, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams;
en.B: 'In the last days it will happen, God says, that I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on all humanity. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy; your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
en.R: 'God says: In the last days I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on people everywhere. Your sons and your daughters will speak messages from God. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.

fr.L: “Et il arrivera dans les derniers jours, dit Dieu, [que] je répandrai de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur toute chair, et vos fils et vos filles prophétiseront, et vos jeunes hommes verront des visions, et vos hommes âgés songeront des songes ;
fr.B: “Dans les derniers jours, il arrivera, dit Dieu, que je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur toute l’humanité. Vos fils et vos filles prophétiseront ; vos jeunes hommes verront des visions et vos hommes âgés feront des rêves.
fr.R: “Dieu dit : Dans les derniers jours, je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur les gens de partout. Vos fils et vos filles transmettront des messages de Dieu. Vos jeunes hommes auront des visions, et vos vieillards feront des rêves.

sw.L: 'Na itakuwa katika siku za mwisho, asema Mungu, [kwamba] nitamimina kutoka kwa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya kila mwenye mwili, na wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, na vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto;
sw.B: 'Itakuwa hivi katika siku za mwisho, asema Mungu: Nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya wanadamu wote. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri; vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto.
sw.R: 'Mungu asema hivi: Katika siku za mwisho nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya watu kila mahali. Wana wenu na binti zenu watanena ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu. Vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto.

es.L: “Y sucederá en los últimos días, dice Dios, [que] derramaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre toda carne, y profetizarán {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ancianos soñarán sueños;
es.B: “En los últimos días sucederá, dice Dios, que derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre toda la humanidad. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas profetizarán; {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ancianos tendrán sueños.
es.R: “Dios dice: En los últimos días derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre gente de todas partes. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} hijos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas darán mensajes de parte de Dios. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} jóvenes verán visiones, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ancianos tendrán sueños.

vi.L: 'Đức Chúa Trời phán: Trong những ngày sau rốt, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi xác thịt; con trai và con gái các ngươi sẽ nói tiên tri, các thanh niên của các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng, và các cụ già của các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao;
vi.B: 'Đức Chúa Trời phán: Trong những ngày sau rốt, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi người. Con trai và con gái các ngươi sẽ nói tiên tri; thanh niên các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng, và người già các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao.
vi.R: 'Đức Chúa Trời phán: Trong những ngày cuối cùng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên mọi người ở khắp nơi. Con trai và con gái các ngươi sẽ nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. Thanh niên các ngươi sẽ thấy khải tượng, và người già các ngươi sẽ thấy chiêm bao.

ko.L: '그리고 마지막 날들에 [이런 일이] 있을 것이다. 하나님께서 말씀하신다. 내가 내 영을 모든 육체에 부어 주겠다. 그러면 너희의 아들들과 너희의 딸들은 예언하고, 너희의 젊은이들은 환상을 보고, 너희의 늙은이들은 꿈을 꿀 것이다.
ko.B: '하나님께서 말씀하신다. 마지막 날에 내가 내 영을 모든 사람에게 부어 주겠다. 너희의 아들딸들은 예언하고, 너희의 젊은이들은 환상을 보고, 너희의 노인들은 꿈을 꿀 것이다.
ko.R: '하나님께서 말씀하신다. 마지막 날에 나는 내 영을 모든 곳의 사람들에게 부어 줄 것이다. 너희의 아들과 딸들이 내 말을 전할 것이다. 너희의 젊은이들은 환상을 보고, 너희의 노인들은 꿈을 꿀 것이다.

pt.L: 'E acontecerá nos últimos dias, diz Deus, [que] derramarei do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre toda carne, e os filhos e as filhas de vocês profetizarão, e os jovens de vocês verão visões, e os velhos de vocês sonharão sonhos;
pt.B: 'Nos últimos dias acontecerá, diz Deus, que derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre toda a humanidade. Os filhos e as filhas de vocês profetizarão; os jovens de vocês terão visões, e os idosos terão sonhos.
pt.R: 'Deus diz: Nos últimos dias vou derramar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito sobre pessoas de todos os lugares. Os filhos e as filhas de vocês vão anunciar mensagens de Deus. Os jovens de vocês vão ter visões, e os velhos vão sonhar.

am.L: “በመጨረሻዎቹ ቀናት እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከመንፈሴ በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፤ ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ ወጣቶቻችሁ ራእይ ያያሉ፤ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልም ያልማሉ፤
am.B: “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በመጨረሻው ዘመን መንፈሴን በሰው ሁሉ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ። ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ ወጣቶቻችሁ ራእይ ያያሉ፤ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልም ያልማሉ።
am.R: “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በመጨረሻው ዘመን መንፈሴን በየትም ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ አፈስሳለሁ። ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር የተቀበሉትን መልእክት ይናገራሉ። ወጣቶቻችሁ ራእይ ያያሉ፤ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልም ያልማሉ።

hi.L: 'और अंतिम दिनों में ऐसा होगा, परमेश्वर कहते हैं, कि मैं अपने आत्मा में से सब प्राणियों पर उँडेलूँगा, और तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे, और तुम्हारे जवान दर्शन देखेंगे, और तुम्हारे बूढ़े स्वप्न देखेंगे;
hi.B: 'अंतिम दिनों में ऐसा होगा, परमेश्वर कहते हैं, कि मैं अपना आत्मा सब मनुष्यों पर उँडेलूँगा। तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे; तुम्हारे जवान दर्शन देखेंगे, और तुम्हारे बूढ़े सपने देखेंगे।
hi.R: 'परमेश्वर कहते हैं: अंतिम दिनों में मैं अपना आत्मा हर जगह के लोगों पर उँडेलूँगा। तुम्हारे बेटे और तुम्हारी बेटियाँ मेरी ओर से संदेश सुनाएँगे। तुम्हारे जवान दर्शन देखेंगे, और तुम्हारे बूढ़े सपने देखेंगे।

ru.L: “И будет в последние дни, говорит Бог, изолью от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа на всякую плоть, и будут пророчествовать ваши сыновья и ваши дочери, и ваши юноши будут видеть видения, и ваши старцы будут видеть сны;
ru.B: “В последние дни, говорит Бог, будет так: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа на всех людей. Ваши сыновья и ваши дочери будут пророчествовать, ваши юноши будут видеть видения, а ваши старцы — сны.
ru.R: “Бог говорит: В последние дни {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа на людей повсюду. Ваши сыновья и ваши дочери будут говорить людям то, что откроет им Бог. Ваши юноши будут видеть видения, а ваши старики будут видеть сны.

uk.L: “І буде в останні дні, каже Бог, [що] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю від {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} Духа на всяке тіло, і пророкуватимуть ваші сини й ваші дочки, і ваші юнаки бачитимуть видіння, і ваші старці снитимуть сни;
uk.B: “В останні дні станеться так, каже Бог, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю свого Духа на всіх людей. Ваші сини й ваші дочки пророкуватимуть, ваші юнаки бачитимуть видіння, а ваші старці матимуть сни.
uk.R: “Бог каже: В останні дні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю свого Духа на людей усюди. Ваші сини й ваші дочки передаватимуть послання від Бога. Ваші юнаки бачитимуть видіння, а ваші старі бачитимуть сни.

ja.L: 『そして、終わりの日々に、こうなる、と神は言われる。わたしは、わたしの霊から、すべての肉の上に注ぐ。そして、あなたがたの息子たちとあなたがたの娘たちは預言し、あなたがたの若者たちは幻を見、あなたがたの老人たちは夢を見る。
ja.B: 『神は言われる。終わりの日に、わたしはわたしの霊をすべての人に注ぐ。あなたがたの息子も娘も預言し、若者たちは幻を見、老人たちは夢を見る。
ja.R: 『神はこう言われる。終わりの日に、わたしはわたしの霊をあらゆる人に注ぐ。あなたたちの息子も娘も、神から与えられた言葉を語る。若い者たちは幻を見、年寄りたちは夢を見る。

decisions.choice: Joel 2:28-32 (3:1-5 in the Hebrew), from the Greek Old Testament
decisions.reason: Peter quotes Joel almost word for word, with a few changes. Joel begins "afterward"; Peter says "in the last days", for the time of the end has begun.

decisions.choice: all flesh: all people, of every kind
decisions.reason: "Flesh" stands for human beings, as in Luke 3:6. The verses go on to name sons and daughters, young and old, and slaves: the Spirit is not only for a few prophets and leaders.

decisions.choice: from my Spirit: a share of the Spirit, poured out
decisions.reason: "From" (as in the Greek Old Testament) speaks of the Spirit poured out as a gift, given to many.

decisions.choice: prophesy: speak a message from God
decisions.reason: To prophesy is to speak for God. What is happening (2:4, 2:11) is an example of it.

decisions.choice: young men and old men: the words are male, and stand for young and old
decisions.reason: In Joel the pairs cover every part of the people. Women are named in "daughters" and in the female slaves (2:18).

decisions.choice: speak messages from God
decisions.reason: Readable says what prophesying is.

decisions.choice: “ ” for the words of Joel (2:17-21) inside Peter's speech
decisions.reason: Peter's speech is already inside « », so the prophecy he quotes takes the inner French quotation marks, as the English uses single marks. The same holds for the psalms in 2:25-28 and 2:34-35.

decisions.choice: Joel's words in “ ” inside Peter's « »
decisions.reason: The quotation of Joel runs from 2:17 to 2:21 inside Peter's speech, so it takes the inner Spanish quotation marks; the plural "your" of the prophecy takes the plural_you setting like the rest of the speech.

decisions.choice: darán mensajes de parte de Dios
decisions.reason: To prophesy is to speak a message from God (meaning decision on prophesy); Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives (Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}); none on verb prefixes (nitamimina)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun, as the English
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns for God inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so only free pronouns and possessives carry the deity_pronoun span, as through Acts. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than the English in this chapter.

decisions.choice: watanena ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu (R); watatabiri (L, B)
decisions.reason: To prophesy is to speak a message from God (meaning decision on "prophesy"); Readable says that, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and speaks to his people as "các ngươi" in Joel's words (2:17-21); the verb is "phán"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "phán" for God speaking. "các ngươi" is the form the Vietnamese Gospels and letters use when God speaks to his people in a quotation of the Old Testament, and marks Joel's words off from Peter's own "anh em".

decisions.choice: "mọi xác thịt" (L); "mọi người" (B), "mọi người ở khắp nơi" (R)
decisions.reason: "All flesh" means all people (meaning decision), as in the Vietnamese Luke 3:6, where Literal keeps "mọi xác thịt" too.

decisions.choice: God speaks in 해라체 with "나" and "너희" through the quotation of Joel (2:17-21); "하나님께서 말씀하신다" with the honorific
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a) gives for God speaking in the prophets. The quotation is in single quotation marks inside Peter's speech, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "모든 육체" (L), "모든 사람" (B, R); "예언하다" (L, B), "내 말을 전하다" (R); "젊은이들", "늙은이들" (L), "노인들" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: All flesh is all people (meaning decision). To prophesy is to speak a message from God; Readable says so. The words for young and old are male but stand for young and old (meaning decision), as the Korean words do.

decisions.choice: os filhos e as filhas de vocês
decisions.reason: God speaks here to the whole people, so the plural "vocês"; "vosso" is not used (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), and "seus" could be read as "their". God's "tu" is for one person addressed.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronouns as in the English setting
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God and Jesus take honorific forms instead ("परमेश्वर कहते हैं"), at every level (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: God says "तुम" to his people in Joel
decisions.reason: God speaking to people uses "तुम", as Jesus does in the Gospels; Peter's own words around the quotation say "आप" to the crowd.

decisions.choice: “ ” for Joel
decisions.reason: Peter's speech is in guillemets, so the prophet he quotes takes the inner marks.

decisions.choice: на всякую плоть
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "all flesh"; Balanced and Readable say "all people".

decisions.choice: the words of Joel in 『』 in the plain style, with God speaking as "わたし"; the narrator's frame "神は言われる" with a respect form
alternatives: です・ます, as in Peter's speech around it
decisions.reason: Quoted Scripture keeps the plain style inside a polite speech, and a quotation inside Peter's 「」 speech takes 『』.

decisions.choice: "神から与えられた言葉を語る" (R) for "prophesy"; "預言する" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what prophesying is (m4), as the English Readable does.

source.text: καί γε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς δούλας μου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And even upon the male slaves of me and upon the female slaves of me in the days those I will pour out from the Spirit of me, and they will prophesy.

en.L: and even upon {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} male slaves and upon {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} female slaves in those days I will pour out from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit, and they will prophesy.
en.B: In those days I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit even on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants, men and women alike, and they will prophesy.
en.R: In those days I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit even on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants, both men and women. And they will speak messages from God.

fr.L: et même sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} esclaves hommes et sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} esclaves femmes, en ces jours-là, je répandrai de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit, et ils prophétiseront.
fr.B: En ces jours-là, je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit même sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs et sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} servantes, et ils prophétiseront.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit même sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent, les hommes comme les femmes. Et ils transmettront des messages de Dieu.

sw.L: na hata juu ya watumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kiume na juu ya watumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kike katika siku zile nitamimina kutoka kwa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nao watatabiri.
sw.B: Katika siku zile nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hata juu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, wanaume kwa wanawake, nao watatabiri.
sw.R: Katika siku hizo nitamimina Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hata juu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, wanaume na wanawake. Nao watanena ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.

es.L: y aun sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} esclavos y sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} esclavas, en aquellos días derramaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu, y profetizarán.
es.B: En aquellos días derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu aun sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervas, y profetizarán.
es.R: En aquellos días derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu incluso sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos, hombres y mujeres. Y ellos darán mensajes de parte de Dios.

vi.L: và ngay cả trên các nam nô lệ và nữ nô lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trong những ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và họ sẽ nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên cả các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nam cũng như nữ, và họ sẽ nói tiên tri.
vi.R: Trong những ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên cả các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cả nam lẫn nữ. Và họ sẽ nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그날들에 내가 내 남종들과 내 여종들에게도 내 영을 부어 주겠다. 그러면 그들이 예언할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 내 종들에게도, 남자에게나 여자에게나 내 영을 부어 주겠다. 그러면 그들이 예언할 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 내 종들에게도, 남자에게나 여자에게나 내 영을 부어 줄 것이다. 그러면 그들도 내 말을 전할 것이다.

pt.L: e até sobre os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} escravos e sobre as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} escravas, naqueles dias, derramarei do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito, e eles profetizarão.
pt.B: Naqueles dias derramarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito até sobre os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} servas, e eles profetizarão.
pt.R: Naqueles dias vou derramar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Espírito até sobre os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} servas. E eles vão anunciar mensagens de Deus.

am.L: ደግሞም በእነዚያ ቀናት በወንዶች ባሪያዎቼና በሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ ላይ ከመንፈሴ አፈስሳለሁ፤ ትንቢትም ይናገራሉ።
am.B: በእነዚያ ቀናት በወንዶችና በሴቶች አገልጋዮቼ ላይ እንኳ መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ፤ እነርሱም ትንቢት ይናገራሉ።
am.R: በእነዚያ ቀናት በወንዶችም በሴቶችም አገልጋዮቼ ላይ እንኳ መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ። እነርሱም ከእግዚአብሔር የተቀበሉትን መልእክት ይናገራሉ።

hi.L: और मैं उन दिनों में अपने दासों और अपनी दासियों पर भी अपने आत्मा में से उँडेलूँगा, और वे भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे।
hi.B: उन दिनों में मैं अपने दास-दासियों पर भी अपना आत्मा उँडेलूँगा, और वे भविष्यद्वाणी करेंगे।
hi.R: उन दिनों में मैं अपने दासों पर भी, चाहे वे पुरुष हों या स्त्रियाँ, अपना आत्मा उँडेलूँगा। और वे मेरी ओर से संदेश सुनाएँगे।

ru.L: и даже на {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов и на {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабынь в те дни изолью от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа, и будут пророчествовать.
ru.B: Даже на {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов и рабынь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью в те дни {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа, и они будут пророчествовать.
ru.R: В те дни {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Духа даже на {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов — и на мужчин, и на женщин. И они будут говорить людям то, что откроет им Бог.

uk.L: і навіть на {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів і на {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабинь у ті дні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю від {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} Духа, і вони пророкуватимуть.
uk.B: У ті дні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю свого Духа навіть на {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів і рабинь, і вони пророкуватимуть.
uk.R: У ті дні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виллю свого Духа навіть на {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів і рабинь. І вони передаватимуть послання від Бога.

ja.L: そして、わたしの男の奴隷たちとわたしの女の奴隷たちの上にさえ、その日々に、わたしはわたしの霊から注ぐ。すると彼らは預言する。
ja.B: その日には、わたしのしもべたちにも、男にも女にも、わたしの霊を注ぐ。すると彼らは預言する。
ja.R: その日には、わたしのしもべたちにも、男にも女にも、わたしの霊を注ぐ。すると、その人たちも神から与えられた言葉を語る。

decisions.choice: my male and female slaves: those of the lowest rank, now God's own servants
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew of Joel they are simply "the male and female slaves", people with no standing. The Greek adds "my", which also makes them God's servants (compare Luke 1:38, 1:48). The Spirit comes down to the lowest and belongs to those who serve God.

decisions.choice: even: the gift reaches further than anyone would expect
decisions.reason: The two small words stress what follows.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: esclavos, esclavas (L); siervos, siervas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The project's rule for the word: "slave" at Literal, "servant" at Balanced and Readable; Spanish has both a masculine and a feminine form, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: watumwa wa kiume, watumwa wa kike (L); watumishi, wanaume kwa wanawake (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: "mtumwa" (slave) in Literal, "mtumishi" (servant) in Balanced and Readable. Swahili has one word for male and female slaves, so Literal adds "wa kiume" and "wa kike" to keep the two Greek words.

decisions.choice: "các nam nô lệ và nữ nô lệ" (L); "các đầy tớ ... nam cũng như nữ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's "nô lệ" (L) and "đầy tớ" (B, R) for doulos.

decisions.choice: "남종들과 여종들" (L); "종들, 남자에게나 여자에게나" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "종" for doulos, as the Korean style guide gives; those of the lowest rank are now God's own servants (meaning decision), so "노예" is not needed.

decisions.choice: "አገልጋዮቼ" (my servants, B, R); "ባሪያዎቼ" (my slaves, L)
decisions.reason: In Joel's words God calls them his own servants; the point is that the Spirit comes even on the lowest, who now belong to God, as the English Balanced and Readable say. Literal keeps the word for slave.

The style guide keeps "दास" for doulos at every level (section 7b), where the English Balanced and Readable say "servants". Here the point is that the gift reaches even those of the lowest rank (meaning decision m1), which "दास" keeps.

decisions.choice: рабы и рабыни at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "servants" at Balanced and Readable; the Russian style guide keeps doulos as "раб" at every level, which also keeps the surprise of the gift reaching the lowest.

decisions.choice: "рабів і рабинь"
alternatives: "слуг", as the English Balanced and Readable say "servants"
decisions.reason: The Ukrainian brief keeps "раб" for doulos at every level; here the point is that the gift reaches even those of the lowest rank, which "раб" keeps.

source.text: καὶ δώσω τέρατα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ σημεῖα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω, αἷμα καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἀτμίδα καπνοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: And I will give wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.

en.L: And I will give wonders in the sky above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
en.B: I will work wonders up in the sky and signs down on the earth: blood and fire and a haze of smoke.
en.R: I will do amazing things in the sky above. And I will show signs on the earth below: blood, fire and thick smoke.

fr.L: Et je donnerai des prodiges dans le ciel en haut et des signes sur la terre en bas, du sang et du feu et une vapeur de fumée.
fr.B: Je ferai des prodiges là-haut dans le ciel et des signes ici-bas sur la terre : du sang, du feu et un nuage de fumée.
fr.R: Je ferai des choses extraordinaires en haut, dans le ciel. Et je montrerai des signes en bas, sur la terre : du sang, du feu et une épaisse fumée.

sw.L: Nami nitatoa maajabu katika anga juu na ishara katika nchi chini, damu na moto na mvuke wa moshi.
sw.B: Nitafanya maajabu juu angani na ishara chini duniani: damu na moto na ukungu wa moshi.
sw.R: Nitafanya mambo ya kushangaza angani juu. Nami nitaonyesha ishara duniani chini: damu, moto na moshi mzito.

es.L: Y daré prodigios en el cielo arriba y señales en la tierra abajo: sangre y fuego y vapor de humo.
es.B: Haré prodigios arriba en el cielo y señales abajo en la tierra: sangre, fuego y una nube de humo.
es.R: Haré cosas asombrosas arriba en el cielo. Y mostraré señales abajo en la tierra: sangre, fuego y humo espeso.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm những điều kỳ diệu ở trên trời và những dấu lạ ở dưới đất: máu, lửa và luồng khói.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm những điều kỳ diệu trên trời cao và những dấu lạ dưới đất thấp: máu, lửa và khói mù mịt.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm những việc lạ lùng trên bầu trời. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho thấy những dấu lạ dưới đất: máu, lửa và khói dày đặc.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 위로 하늘에는 기사들을, 아래로 땅에는 표적들을 주겠다. 피와 불과 연기 기둥이다.
ko.B: 내가 위로는 하늘에 놀라운 일들을, 아래로는 땅에 표적들을 나타내겠다. 피와 불과 자욱한 연기다.
ko.R: 나는 위로 하늘에서 놀라운 일들을 할 것이다. 아래로 땅에서는 표적들을 보여 줄 것이다. 피와 불과 짙은 연기가 있을 것이다.

pt.L: E darei prodígios no céu em cima e sinais na terra embaixo, sangue e fogo e vapor de fumaça.
pt.B: Farei prodígios no alto do céu e sinais aqui embaixo na terra: sangue, fogo e uma nuvem de fumaça.
pt.R: Vou fazer coisas espantosas lá em cima no céu. E vou mostrar sinais aqui embaixo na terra: sangue, fogo e fumaça espessa.

am.L: በላይ በሰማይ ድንቆችን፣ በታችም በምድር ላይ ምልክቶችን እሰጣለሁ፤ ደምና እሳት የጢስም ጭጋግ፤
am.B: በላይ በሰማይ ድንቅ ነገሮችን፣ በታች በምድርም ምልክቶችን አደርጋለሁ፤ ደም፣ እሳትና የጢስ ጭጋግ ይሆናል።
am.R: በላይ በሰማይ አስደናቂ ነገሮችን አደርጋለሁ። በታች በምድርም ምልክቶችን አሳያለሁ፤ ደም፣ እሳትና ጥቅጥቅ ያለ ጢስ ይታያል።

hi.L: और मैं ऊपर आकाश में अद्भुत काम और नीचे पृथ्वी पर चिह्न दूँगा, लहू और आग और धुएँ का बादल।
hi.B: मैं ऊपर आकाश में अद्भुत काम और नीचे धरती पर चिह्न दिखाऊँगा: लहू और आग और धुएँ की धुंध।
hi.R: मैं ऊपर आकाश में अचंभे की बातें करूँगा। और नीचे धरती पर चिह्न दिखाऊँगा: लहू, आग और घना धुआँ।

ru.L: И дам чудеса на небе вверху и знамения на земле внизу, кровь и огонь и курение дыма.
ru.B: Я совершу чудеса вверху на небе и знамения внизу на земле: кровь, огонь и клубы дыма.
ru.R: Я сделаю удивительные дела на небе. И на земле {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу знаки: кровь, огонь и густой дым.

uk.L: І дам дива на небі вгорі і знаки на землі внизу: кров, і вогонь, і пару диму.
uk.B: Я вчиню дива вгорі на небі й знаки внизу на землі: кров, і вогонь, і клуби диму.
uk.R: Я зроблю дивовижні речі на небі вгорі. І покажу знаки на землі внизу: кров, вогонь і густий дим.

ja.L: また、わたしは上では天に不思議な業を、下では地にしるしを与える。血と火と煙の蒸気である。
ja.B: わたしは、上は空に不思議な業を、下は地にしるしを行う。血と火と、立ちこめる煙である。
ja.R: わたしは、上の空で不思議なことを行い、下の地上でしるしを見せる。血と火と、もうもうとした煙である。

decisions.choice: wonders and signs: astonishing events that point to God
decisions.reason: Peter adds "signs", "above" and "below" to Joel. The same pair describes what God did through Jesus (2:22) and the apostles (2:43).

decisions.choice: blood, fire and smoke: the marks of God coming in power and judgment
decisions.reason: Fire and smoke marked God's coming down on Sinai (Exodus 19:18). In the prophets, blood and darkening skies go with the day of the Lord (Joel 2:10).

decisions.choice: the sky: the word means both sky and heaven
decisions.reason: Here it is the sky above, set against the earth below.

decisions.choice: amazing things
decisions.reason: Readable says "wonders" in everyday words; "signs" stays.

decisions.choice: "những điều kỳ diệu" for wonders and "những dấu lạ" for signs (also 2:22, 2:43)
decisions.reason: "dấu lạ" is the style guide's word for "sign"; "điều kỳ diệu" keeps the pair of words apart, as Greek and English do.

decisions.choice: "기사" (L), "놀라운 일" (B, R) for terata; "표적" for sēmeia at every level
decisions.reason: "표적" is the settled word for a sign (style guide, section 6); the wonders are kept apart from it with their own word, as the pair returns through Acts (2:22; 2:43).

decisions.choice: "अद्भुत काम" (L, B); "अचंभे की बातें" (R); "चिह्न"
decisions.reason: The pair "wonders and signs" in the Gospels' words (Matthew 24:24); it recurs through Acts (2:22, 2:43).

decisions.choice: чудеса и знамения (L, B); удивительные дела, знаки (R)
decisions.reason: The pair "wonders and signs", the book's recurring phrase, is "чудеса и знамения" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "знаки" for signs, as settled in John.

decisions.choice: "дива" for terata, "знаки" for sēmeia
decisions.reason: "чудеса" is kept for dynameis (2:22), so the three Greek words for deeds of power stay apart in Acts: чудеса, дива, знаки.

source.text: ὁ ἥλιος μεταστραφήσεται εἰς σκότος καὶ ἡ σελήνη εἰς αἷμα πρὶν ἢ ἐλθεῖν ἡμέραν κυρίου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐπιφανῆ.

records.literal_gloss: The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before to come [the] day of Lord the great and glorious.

en.L: The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before the coming of [the] day of [the] Lord, the great and glorious [day].
en.B: The sun will turn dark and the moon to blood before the great and splendid day of the Lord arrives.
en.R: The sun will become dark, and the moon will become red like blood. Then the Lord's great and wonderful day will come.

fr.L: Le soleil sera changé en ténèbres et la lune en sang, avant que vienne le jour du Seigneur, grand et éclatant.
fr.B: Le soleil s’obscurcira et la lune deviendra sang, avant que n’arrive le jour du Seigneur, grand et resplendissant.
fr.R: Le soleil deviendra sombre, et la lune deviendra rouge comme du sang. Puis le grand et merveilleux jour du Seigneur arrivera.

sw.L: Jua litageuzwa kuwa giza na mwezi kuwa damu, kabla ya kuja kwa siku ya Bwana, ile [siku] kuu na tukufu.
sw.B: Jua litatiwa giza, na mwezi utakuwa damu, kabla ya kufika kwa siku ya Bwana iliyo kuu na yenye fahari.
sw.R: Jua litakuwa giza, na mwezi utakuwa mwekundu kama damu. Kisha siku ya Bwana iliyo kuu na ya ajabu itakuja.

es.L: El sol se convertirá en tinieblas y la luna en sangre, antes que venga [el] día del Señor, el grande y glorioso.
es.B: El sol se oscurecerá y la luna se volverá sangre antes de que llegue el día del Señor, grande y esplendoroso.
es.R: El sol se pondrá oscuro, y la luna se pondrá roja como la sangre. Entonces llegará el día grande y maravilloso del Señor.

vi.L: Mặt trời sẽ biến thành tối tăm và mặt trăng thành máu, trước khi ngày lớn và vinh hiển của Chúa đến.
vi.B: Mặt trời sẽ trở nên tối tăm, và mặt trăng đỏ như máu, trước khi ngày lớn và rực rỡ của Chúa đến.
vi.R: Mặt trời sẽ tối lại, và mặt trăng sẽ đỏ như máu. Rồi ngày lớn lao và kỳ diệu của Chúa sẽ đến.

ko.L: 주님의 크고 영광스러운 날이 오기 전에, 해는 어둠으로 바뀌고 달은 피로 [바뀔 것이다].
ko.B: 주님의 크고 영광스러운 날이 오기 전에, 해가 어두워지고 달이 피처럼 붉게 변할 것이다.
ko.R: 해가 어두워지고, 달은 피처럼 붉어질 것이다. 그런 다음 주님의 크고 놀라운 날이 올 것이다.

pt.L: O sol se transformará em trevas e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o dia do Senhor, o grande e glorioso [dia].
pt.B: O sol se tornará escuro, e a lua, sangue, antes que chegue o grande e esplêndido dia do Senhor.
pt.R: O sol vai ficar escuro, e a lua vai ficar vermelha como sangue. Depois virá o grande e maravilhoso dia do Senhor.

am.L: ታላቁና ገናናው የጌታ ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ፣ ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ትለወጣለች።
am.B: ታላቁና ክቡሩ የጌታ ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት ፀሐይ ትጨልማለች፤ ጨረቃም እንደ ደም ትሆናለች።
am.R: ፀሐይ ትጨልማለች፤ ጨረቃም እንደ ደም ትቀላለች። ከዚያም ታላቁና አስደናቂው የጌታ ቀን ይመጣል።

hi.L: सूर्य अंधकार में और चाँद लहू में बदल जाएगा, इससे पहले कि प्रभु का महान और महिमामय दिन आए।
hi.B: प्रभु के महान और तेजस्वी दिन के आने से पहले सूर्य अँधेरा हो जाएगा और चाँद लहू-सा हो जाएगा।
hi.R: सूरज अँधेरा हो जाएगा, और चाँद लहू की तरह लाल हो जाएगा। फिर प्रभु का महान और अद्भुत दिन आएगा।

ru.L: Солнце превратится во тьму и луна в кровь, прежде чем придёт день Господа, великий и славный.
ru.B: Солнце станет тёмным, а луна кровавой, прежде чем наступит великий и славный день Господа.
ru.R: Солнце потемнеет, а луна станет красной, как кровь. А потом придёт великий и чудесный день Господа.

uk.L: Сонце обернеться на темряву, а місяць на кров, перш ніж прийде день Господній, великий і славний [день].
uk.B: Сонце потемніє, а місяць обернеться на кров, перш ніж настане великий і величний день Господній.
uk.R: Сонце стане темним, а місяць стане червоним, як кров. Тоді настане великий і чудовий день Господа.

ja.L: 主の大いなる輝かしい[日]が来る前に、太陽は闇に、月は血に変わる。
ja.B: 主の大いなる輝かしい日が来る前に、太陽は暗くなり、月は血に変わる。
ja.R: 太陽は暗くなり、月は血のように赤くなる。そのあとで、主の大いなるすばらしい日が来る。

decisions.choice: the day of the Lord: the day God comes to judge and to save
decisions.reason: In Joel the day of the LORD is the day God acts against evil and rescues his people (Joel 2:1, 2:11, 2:31). The Hebrew has the divine name; the Greek has "Lord".

decisions.choice: glorious: openly seen, splendid
decisions.reason: The Greek word means "made manifest, splendid". Joel's Hebrew reads "fearful" (Joel 2:31); the Greek Old Testament, which Peter quotes, has this word.

decisions.choice: the moon into blood: the moon turned dark red
decisions.reason: A picture of the heavens darkened and changed before the day comes (Joel 2:10).

decisions.choice: red like blood
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture looks like, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for the Lord in Joel's words, with no divine-name setting
decisions.reason: Peter quotes the Greek Old Testament, which says "Lord", and goes on to call Jesus Lord (meaning decision), so it is "Chúa", as in the Vietnamese Luke 4:18-19 and Romans 10:13.

decisions.choice: "주님의 날" at every level for the day of the Lord, with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: In the New Testament the Greek "kyrios" is rendered "주님", as the Korean Luke 10:27 and Romans 10:13 do in quotations; the divine name setting belongs to the Hebrew Scriptures.

source.text: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σωθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: And it will be everyone who if calls upon the name of Lord will be saved.

en.L: And it will be [that] everyone who calls upon the name of [the] Lord will be saved.'
en.B: Then whoever calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'
en.R: And the Lord will save everyone who calls to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for help.'

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] quiconque invoquera le nom du Seigneur sera sauvé.”
fr.B: Alors tous ceux qui feront appel au nom du Seigneur seront sauvés.”
fr.R: Et le Seigneur sauvera tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelleront à l’aide.”

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] kila atakayeliitia jina la Bwana ataokolewa.'
sw.B: Ndipo kila atakayeliitia jina la Bwana ataokolewa.'
sw.R: Bwana atamwokoa kila mtu atakayemlilia ili amsaidie.'

es.L: Y sucederá [que] todo el que invoque el nombre del Señor será salvo”.
es.B: Entonces todo el que invoque el nombre del Señor será salvo”.
es.R: Y el Señor salvará a todo el que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pida ayuda”.

vi.L: Và mọi người kêu cầu danh Chúa sẽ được cứu.'
vi.B: Rồi ai kêu cầu danh Chúa đều sẽ được cứu.'
vi.R: Và Chúa sẽ cứu mọi người kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ.'

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 이름을 부르는 사람은 누구나 구원을 받을 [것이다].'
ko.B: 그때 주님의 이름을 부르는 사람은 누구나 구원을 받을 것이다.'
ko.R: 그리고 주님께 도와 달라고 부르짖는 사람은 누구나 주님께서 구원하실 것이다.'

pt.L: E acontecerá [que] todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.'
pt.B: E então todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.'
pt.R: E o Senhor vai salvar todos os que pedirem ajuda a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.'

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ይድናል።”
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ የጌታን ስም ጠርቶ የሚለምን ሁሉ ይድናል።”
am.R: እርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ ጌታ የሚጣራውን ሁሉ ጌታ ያድነዋል።”

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा कि जो कोई प्रभु का नाम पुकारेगा, वह उद्धार पाएगा।'
hi.B: तब जो कोई प्रभु का नाम पुकारेगा, वह उद्धार पाएगा।'
hi.R: और जो कोई मदद के लिए प्रभु को पुकारेगा, प्रभु उसे बचाएँगे।'

ru.L: И будет [так]: всякий, кто призовёт имя Господа, будет спасён.”
ru.B: И тогда всякий, кто призовёт имя Господа, будет спасён.”
ru.R: И Господь спасёт каждого, кто позовёт {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на помощь.”

uk.L: І буде [так, що] кожен, хто прикличе імʼя Господа, буде спасений.”
uk.B: Тоді кожен, хто прикличе імʼя Господа, буде спасений.”
uk.R: І Господь врятує кожного, хто кличе {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} на допомогу.”

ja.L: そして、主の名を呼び求める者は皆、救われる、ということになる。』
ja.B: そのとき、主の名を呼び求める者は皆、救われる。』
ja.R: 主に助けを求めて呼ぶ人は、だれでも主に救われる。』

decisions.choice: call upon the name of the Lord: pray to him, turn to him for rescue
decisions.reason: To call on someone's name is to appeal to that person and trust them (Genesis 4:26; Psalm 116:4).

decisions.choice: the Lord: in Joel the LORD God; Peter goes on to name Jesus as Lord
alternatives: God only, with no thought of Jesus
decisions.reason: Joel's Hebrew has the divine name. Peter ends by saying God made Jesus Lord (2:36) and calls for baptism "in the name of Jesus" (2:38). Paul quotes this verse of Jesus in Romans 10:9-13.

decisions.choice: the Lord will save everyone who calls to him for help
alternatives: everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who saves and says what calling on his name means.

decisions.choice: Worded as the Vietnamese Romans 10:13, which quotes the same line
decisions.reason: Where the Vietnamese New Testament already quotes a verse, the wording is reused so that readers meet the same words.

decisions.choice: the wording of the Korean Romans 10:13, which quotes the same verse
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the same line of Joel; the Korean keeps the two alike, as the batch brief asks for the Old Testament in the New.

source.text: Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τούτους.

records.literal_gloss: Men Israelites, hear the words these:

en.L: Men, Israelites, hear these words:
en.B: {{gender:People|Men}} of Israel, listen to what I am saying:
en.R: People of Israel, listen to me!

fr.L: Hommes, Israélites, écoutez ces paroles :
fr.B: {{gender:Israélites|Hommes d’Israël}}, écoutez ce que je vais dire :
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, écoutez-moi !

sw.L: Wanaume, Waisraeli, sikieni maneno haya:
sw.B: Enyi Waisraeli, sikilizeni ninayosema:
sw.R: Ninyi watu wa Israeli, nisikilizeni!

es.L: Hombres israelitas, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} estas palabras:
es.B: {{gender:Israelitas|Hombres de Israel}}, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que voy a decir:
es.R: ¡Pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}!

vi.L: Thưa các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe những lời này:
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên|các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên}}, xin hãy nghe những lời tôi nói đây:
vi.R: Thưa đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin hãy nghe tôi!

ko.L: 이스라엘 사람 여러분, 이 말을 들으십시오.
ko.B: 이스라엘 사람 여러분, 내가 하는 말을 들으십시오.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람 여러분, 내 말을 들으십시오!

pt.L: Homens, israelitas, ouçam estas palavras:
pt.B: {{gender:Israelitas|Homens de Israel}}, ouçam o que vou dizer:
pt.R: Povo de Israel, escutem o que eu digo!

am.L: የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፣ እነዚህን ቃላት ስሙ፦
am.B: የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፣ የምናገረውን አድምጡ፦
am.R: እናንተ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ፣ ስሙኝ!

hi.L: हे इस्राएली पुरुषो, ये बातें सुनिए:
hi.B: {{gender:हे इस्राएल के लोगो|हे इस्राएल के पुरुषो}}, मेरी बात सुनिए:
hi.R: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, मेरी बात सुनिए!

ru.L: Мужи израильтяне, слушайте эти слова:
ru.B: {{gender:Израильтяне|Мужи израильские}}, выслушайте то, что я говорю:
ru.R: Народ Израиля, послушайте меня!

uk.L: Мужі ізраїльтяни, послухайте ці слова:
uk.B: {{gender:Ізраїльтяни|Мужі ізраїльські}}, послухайте, що я кажу:
uk.R: Народе Ізраїлю, слухайте мене!

ja.L: イスラエルの人たち、これらの言葉を聞いてください。
ja.B: {{gender:イスラエルの人たち|イスラエルの男たち}}、わたしの言うことを聞いてください。
ja.R: イスラエルのみなさん、聞いてください。

decisions.choice: men, Israelites: a formal address to the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Peter calls his hearers by the name of God's people. As at 2:14, the whole crowd is likely meant.

decisions.choice: People of Israel, with "Men of Israel" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The inclusive default follows the meaning note; Literal keeps "men".

decisions.choice: {{gender:Israelitas|Hombres de Israel}}
decisions.reason: As in 3:12: the default names the whole people, with the traditional address as the alternative.

decisions.choice: Enyi Waisraeli (B); Ninyi watu wa Israeli (R), no gender span
alternatives: a gender span like the English People / Men of Israel
decisions.reason: As in 3:12: "Waisraeli" and "watu wa Israeli" already include women, and "wanaume" (males) would narrow the meaning, so Swahili has no second wording for the gender setting.

decisions.choice: "Thưa các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "Thưa {{gender:đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên|các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên}}" (B); "Thưa đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:14: the formal address to the people of Israel (meaning decision), with the English setting at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 사람 여러분" at every level, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span giving "이스라엘 남자" as the alternative (B)
decisions.reason: As at 2:14: "사람" already includes women and men, and "여러분" carries the formality of "men".

decisions.choice: "हे इस्राएल के लोगो", with "हे इस्राएल के पुरुषो" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As at 2:14; Literal keeps "पुरुषो", and Readable says "लोगो" with no span, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Израильтяне, with "Мужи израильские" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As at 2:14: the inclusive address is the default; Literal keeps "men".

source.text: Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον, ἄνδρα ἀποδεδειγμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς δυνάμεσι καὶ τέρασι καὶ σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησεν δι’ αὐτοῦ ὁ θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, καθὼς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε, τοῦτον τῇ ὡρισμένῃ βουλῇ καὶ προγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ ἔκδοτον διὰ χειρὸς ἀνόμων προσπήξαντες ἀνείλατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἀνέστησεν λύσας τὰς ὠδῖνας τοῦ θανάτου, καθότι οὐκ ἦν δυνατὸν κρατεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Jesus the Nazarene, a man attested by the God to you by miracles and wonders and signs which did through him the God in [the] midst of you, as yourselves you know, \v 23 this [one] by the set plan and foreknowledge of the God given up, through hand of lawless [men] having fastened [him] you killed, \v 24 whom the God raised up, having loosed the pains of the death, since not it was possible to be held him by it.

en.L: Jesus the Nazarene, a man attested by God to you by miracles and wonders and signs which God did through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in your midst, as you yourselves know, \v 23 this [man], given up by the set plan and foreknowledge of God, you killed, fastening [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to a cross] by [the] hand of lawless [men], \v 24 whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be held by it.
en.B: Jesus of Nazareth was a man whom God commended to you by deeds of power, wonders and signs that God worked through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} among you, as you well know. \v 23 God had set the plan and known it beforehand: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was handed over, and you, through the hands of lawless men, fastened {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to a cross and killed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 24 But God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up and freed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the pains of death, since there was no way death could hold {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} fast.
en.R: God showed you that Jesus from Nazareth came from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. God did miracles, wonders and signs through Jesus while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was among you. You know this yourselves. \v 23 It was God's plan that Jesus would be handed over to you, and God knew it would happen. You used men who did not know God's law to nail {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to a cross and kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 24 But God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from death. God set {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} free from the pain of death, because death could not keep its hold on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Jésus le Nazaréen, homme accrédité par Dieu auprès de vous par des miracles et des prodiges et des signes que Dieu a faits par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} au milieu de vous, comme vous le savez vous-mêmes, \v 23 celui-là, livré selon le dessein arrêté et la prescience de Dieu, vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avez fait mourir en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} clouant [à une croix] par la main d’hommes sans loi, \v 24 {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que Dieu a ressuscité, en déliant les douleurs de la mort, parce qu’il n’était pas possible qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit retenu par elle.
fr.B: Jésus de Nazareth était un homme que Dieu vous a désigné par des actes de puissance, des prodiges et des signes que Dieu a accomplis par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parmi vous, comme vous le savez bien. \v 23 Dieu avait arrêté son plan et le connaissait d’avance : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été livré, et vous, par la main d’hommes sans loi, vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avez cloué à une croix et mis à mort. \v 24 Mais Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a délivré des douleurs de la mort, car il était impossible que la mort {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} retienne.
fr.R: Dieu vous a montré que Jésus de Nazareth venait de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Dieu a fait des miracles, des prodiges et des signes par Jésus quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était parmi vous. Vous le savez vous-mêmes. \v 23 Dieu avait prévu que Jésus vous serait livré, et Dieu savait que cela arriverait. Vous vous êtes servis d’hommes qui ne connaissaient pas la Loi de Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} clouer sur une croix et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tuer. \v 24 Mais Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a libéré de la douleur de la mort, parce que la mort ne pouvait pas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} garder.

sw.L: Yesu Mnazareti, mtu aliyethibitishwa kwenu na Mungu kwa matendo ya nguvu na maajabu na ishara ambazo Mungu alizifanya kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} katikati yenu, kama ninyi wenyewe mjuavyo, \v 23 huyu, aliyetolewa kwa shauri lililopangwa na ujuzi wa tangu awali wa Mungu, ninyi mlimwua, mkimgongomea [msalabani] kwa mkono wa watu wasio na sheria, \v 24 ambaye Mungu alimfufua, akiyafungua maumivu ya mauti, kwa kuwa haikuwezekana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kushikiliwa nayo.
sw.B: Yesu wa Nazareti alikuwa mtu ambaye Mungu alimthibitisha kwenu kwa matendo ya nguvu, maajabu na ishara ambazo Mungu alizifanya kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kati yenu, kama mnavyojua vyema. \v 23 Mungu alikuwa ameweka mpango huo na kuujua tangu mwanzo: Yesu alitolewa mikononi mwenu, nanyi, kwa mikono ya watu wasio na sheria, mkamgongomea msalabani na kumwua. \v 24 Lakini Mungu alimfufua na kumweka huru kutoka katika maumivu ya mauti, kwa kuwa haikuwezekana mauti kumshikilia.
sw.R: Mungu aliwaonyesha kwamba Yesu wa Nazareti alitoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Mungu alifanya miujiza, maajabu na ishara kupitia Yesu alipokuwa kati yenu. Mnajua jambo hili wenyewe. \v 23 Ulikuwa mpango wa Mungu kwamba Yesu atolewe mikononi mwenu, na Mungu alijua kwamba hilo lingetokea. Mliwatumia watu wasioijua sheria ya Mungu kumgongomea msalabani na kumwua. \v 24 Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Mungu alimweka huru kutoka katika maumivu ya kifo, kwa sababu kifo hakingeweza kumshikilia.

es.L: A Jesús el Nazareno, hombre acreditado por Dios ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con milagros y prodigios y señales que Dios hizo por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, como {{plural_you:ustedes mismos saben|vosotros mismos sabéis}}, \v 23 a este, entregado según el designio determinado y el conocimiento previo de Dios, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:mataron|matasteis}}, clavándolo [en una cruz] por mano de [hombres] sin ley, \v 24 a quien Dios resucitó, habiendo desatado los dolores de la muerte, por cuanto no era posible que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fuera retenido por ella.
es.B: Jesús de Nazaret fue un hombre a quien Dios acreditó ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con obras poderosas, prodigios y señales que Dios hizo por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, como bien {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}}. \v 23 Dios tenía determinado el plan y lo sabía de antemano: Jesús fue entregado, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, por manos de hombres sin ley, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:clavaron|clavasteis}} en una cruz y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:mataron|matasteis}}. \v 24 Pero Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} libró de los dolores de la muerte, porque era imposible que la muerte {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} retuviera.
es.R: Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} mostró que Jesús de Nazaret venía de parte de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Dios hizo milagros, prodigios y señales por medio de Jesús mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos lo saben|Vosotros mismos lo sabéis}}. \v 23 Era el plan de Dios que Jesús fuera entregado en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos, y Dios sabía que eso iba a pasar. {{plural_you:Ustedes usaron|Vosotros usasteis}} a hombres que no conocían la ley de Dios para clavarlo en una cruz y matarlo. \v 24 Pero Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} libró del dolor de la muerte, porque la muerte no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podía retener.

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu người Na-xa-rét là người đã được Đức Chúa Trời chứng nhận cho anh em bằng những việc quyền năng, những điều kỳ diệu và những dấu lạ mà Đức Chúa Trời đã làm qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa anh em, như chính anh em đã biết; \v 23 người ấy đã bị nộp theo kế hoạch đã định và sự biết trước của Đức Chúa Trời, và anh em đã mượn tay những kẻ không có luật pháp mà đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [trên cây thập tự] và giết đi; \v 24 nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại, giải thoát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi những cơn đau của sự chết, vì sự chết không thể giữ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại được.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu người Na-xa-rét là người được Đức Chúa Trời chứng nhận trước mặt anh em bằng những việc quyền năng, những điều kỳ diệu và những dấu lạ mà Đức Chúa Trời đã làm qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa anh em, như chính anh em biết rõ. \v 23 Đức Chúa Trời đã định kế hoạch ấy và biết trước mọi điều: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bị nộp, và anh em đã mượn tay những kẻ không có luật pháp mà đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cây thập tự và giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 24 Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại và giải thoát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi những cơn đau của sự chết, vì sự chết không thể nào giữ chặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã cho anh em thấy rằng Đức Giê-xu người Na-xa-rét đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đức Chúa Trời đã làm những phép lạ, những việc kỳ diệu và những dấu lạ qua Đức Giê-xu khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa anh em. Chính anh em biết điều đó. \v 23 Theo kế hoạch của Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Giê-xu bị nộp vào tay anh em, và Đức Chúa Trời đã biết trước việc ấy sẽ xảy ra. Anh em đã dùng tay những người không biết luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời để đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cây thập tự và giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 24 Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết. Đức Chúa Trời đã giải thoát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi nỗi đau của sự chết, vì sự chết không thể nào giữ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại được.

ko.L: 나사렛 사람 예수는 하나님께서 여러분에게 능력 있는 일들과 기사들과 표적들로 인정해 주신 분입니다. 여러분도 알다시피, 하나님께서 그분을 통하여 여러분 가운데서 그 일들을 행하셨습니다. \v 23 이분이 하나님의 정하신 뜻과 미리 아심을 따라 넘겨지셨는데, 여러분은 불법한 사람들의 손을 빌려 [십자가에] 못 박아 죽였습니다. \v 24 그러나 하나님께서는 사망의 고통을 풀어 그분을 살리셨습니다. 그분이 사망에 붙잡혀 계실 수가 없었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나사렛 예수는 하나님께서 여러분에게 인정해 보이신 분입니다. 여러분도 잘 알다시피, 하나님께서는 이분을 통하여 여러분 가운데서 능력 있는 일들과 놀라운 일들과 표적들을 행하셨습니다. \v 23 하나님께서는 계획을 정하시고 미리 아셨습니다. 그래서 이분이 넘겨지셨고, 여러분은 율법 없는 사람들의 손을 빌려 이분을 십자가에 못 박아 죽였습니다. \v 24 그러나 하나님께서는 이분을 죽음의 고통에서 풀어 살리셨습니다. 죽음이 이분을 붙잡아 둘 수는 없었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 나사렛에서 오신 예수께서 하나님께로부터 오신 분이라는 것을 여러분에게 보여 주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 예수께서 여러분 가운데 계실 때에 예수를 통하여 기적과 놀라운 일과 표적을 행하셨습니다. 여러분도 이 일을 직접 알고 있습니다. \v 23 예수께서 여러분에게 넘겨지신 것은 하나님의 계획이었고, 하나님께서는 그 일이 일어날 것을 미리 아셨습니다. 여러분은 하나님의 율법을 모르는 사람들을 시켜, 예수를 십자가에 못 박아 죽였습니다. \v 24 그러나 하나님께서는 예수를 죽음에서 살리셨습니다. 하나님께서 예수를 죽음의 고통에서 풀어 주셨습니다. 죽음은 예수를 붙잡아 둘 수 없었기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Jesus, o nazareno, homem aprovado por Deus diante de vocês com milagres, prodígios e sinais que Deus realizou por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} no meio de vocês, como vocês mesmos sabem, \v 23 a este, entregue pelo plano determinado e pela presciência de Deus, vocês mataram, pregando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} [numa cruz] por mão de [homens] sem lei, \v 24 a quem Deus ressuscitou, tendo desfeito as dores da morte, porque não era possível que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fosse retido por ela.
pt.B: Jesus de Nazaré foi um homem que Deus aprovou diante de vocês por meio de milagres, prodígios e sinais que Deus realizou por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} entre vocês, como vocês bem sabem. \v 23 Deus tinha determinado o plano e o conhecia de antemão: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi entregue, e vocês, pelas mãos de homens sem a Lei, {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} pregaram numa cruz e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} mataram. \v 24 Mas Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} libertou das dores da morte, pois não era possível que a morte {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} retivesse.
pt.R: Deus mostrou a vocês que Jesus de Nazaré tinha vindo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Deus fez milagres, maravilhas e sinais por meio de Jesus enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava entre vocês. Vocês mesmos sabem disso. \v 23 Era o plano de Deus que Jesus fosse entregue a vocês, e Deus sabia que isso ia acontecer. Vocês usaram homens que não conheciam a Lei de Deus para pregá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} numa cruz e matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. \v 24 Mas Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} libertou da dor da morte, porque a morte não podia continuar a {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} prender.

am.L: ናዝራዊውን ኢየሱስን፣ እናንተ ራሳችሁ እንደምታውቁት እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ በእርሱ በኩል ባደረጋቸው ተአምራትና ድንቆች ምልክቶችም እግዚአብሔር ለእናንተ የመሰከረለትን ሰው፣ \v 23 ይህን በእግዚአብሔር በተወሰነው ምክርና አስቀድሞ በማወቁ ተላልፎ የተሰጠውን በዓመፀኞች እጅ [በመስቀል ላይ] ቸንክራችሁ ገደላችሁት፤ \v 24 እግዚአብሔርም የሞትን ምጥ ፈትቶ አስነሣው፤ በእርሱ ተይዞ ሊቀር አይቻልም ነበርና።
am.B: የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ በኩል በመካከላችሁ በሠራቸው ታላላቅ ሥራዎች፣ ድንቆችና ምልክቶች ለእናንተ የገለጠው ሰው ነበረ፤ ይህንንም እናንተ ራሳችሁ በሚገባ ታውቃላችሁ። \v 23 እግዚአብሔር ዕቅዱን ወስኖ ነበር፤ አስቀድሞም ያውቀው ነበር፤ ኢየሱስም ተላልፎ ተሰጠ፤ እናንተም በዓመፀኞች እጅ በመስቀል ላይ ቸንክራችሁ ገደላችሁት። \v 24 እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሞት ጣር ፈትቶ አስነሣው፤ ሞት ይዞ ሊያስቀረው የሚችልበት ምንም መንገድ አልነበረምና።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ከእርሱ የመጣ መሆኑን አሳያችሁ። ኢየሱስ በመካከላችሁ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ በኩል ተአምራትን፣ ድንቆችንና ምልክቶችን አደረገ። ይህን እናንተ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ። \v 23 ኢየሱስ ለእናንተ ተላልፎ እንዲሰጥ የእግዚአብሔር ዕቅድ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይህ እንደሚሆን ያውቅ ነበር። እናንተም የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ የማያውቁ ሰዎችን ተጠቅማችሁ በመስቀል ላይ ቸንክራችሁ ገደላችሁት። \v 24 እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሞት አስነሣው። ከሞት ሥቃይ ነፃ አወጣው፤ ሞት ይዞ ሊያስቀረው አልቻለምና።

hi.L: यीशु नासरी, एक पुरुष जिनके विषय में परमेश्वर ने आपके सामने उन सामर्थ्य के कामों और अद्भुत कामों और चिह्नों के द्वारा प्रमाण दिया, जो परमेश्वर ने उनके द्वारा आपके बीच में किए, जैसा आप स्वयं जानते हैं, \v 23 उन्हीं को, जो परमेश्वर की ठहराई हुई योजना और पूर्वज्ञान के अनुसार पकड़वाए गए, आपने अधर्मियों के हाथ से [क्रूस पर] ठुकवाकर मार डाला, \v 24 जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने मृत्यु की पीड़ाओं से छुड़ाकर जिलाया, क्योंकि यह अनहोना था कि वे उसके वश में रहते।
hi.B: नासरत के यीशु वे पुरुष थे जिनके बारे में परमेश्वर ने आपके सामने सामर्थ्य के कामों, अद्भुत कामों और चिह्नों से प्रमाण दिया, जो परमेश्वर ने उनके द्वारा आपके बीच किए, जैसा आप अच्छी तरह जानते हैं। \v 23 परमेश्वर ने यह योजना ठहराई थी और वे इसे पहले से जानते थे: यीशु पकड़वाए गए, और आपने अधर्मी लोगों के हाथों उन्हें क्रूस पर ठुकवाकर मार डाला। \v 24 पर परमेश्वर ने उन्हें जिला उठाया और मृत्यु की पीड़ाओं से छुड़ाया, क्योंकि यह हो ही नहीं सकता था कि मृत्यु उन्हें जकड़े रहती।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने आपको दिखाया कि नासरत के यीशु उन्हीं की ओर से आए थे। जब यीशु आपके बीच थे, तब परमेश्वर ने उनके द्वारा सामर्थ्य के काम, अद्भुत काम और चिह्न किए। यह आप ख़ुद जानते हैं। \v 23 परमेश्वर की योजना थी कि यीशु आपके हाथ सौंपे जाएँ, और परमेश्वर जानते थे कि ऐसा होगा। आपने उन लोगों से, जो परमेश्वर की व्यवस्था को नहीं जानते थे, उन्हें क्रूस पर कीलों से ठुकवाया और मरवा डाला। \v 24 पर परमेश्वर ने उन्हें मरे हुओं में से जिला उठाया। परमेश्वर ने उन्हें मृत्यु की पीड़ा से छुड़ा दिया, क्योंकि मृत्यु उन्हें अपनी पकड़ में नहीं रख सकती थी।

ru.L: Иисуса Назорея, мужа, засвидетельствованного вам от Бога силами и чудесами и знамениями, которые совершил через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} Бог среди вас, как вы и сами знаете, \v 23 этого, по определённому замыслу и предведению Божьему преданного, вы руками беззаконных, пригвоздив [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ко кресту], убили, \v 24 но Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, разрешив муки смерти, потому что невозможно было, чтобы она удерживала {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Иисус из Назарета был человеком, которого Бог подтвердил перед вами силами, чудесами и знамениями. Их Бог совершил через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} среди вас, как вы и сами хорошо знаете. \v 23 Бог заранее определил и предвидел это: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был предан, и вы руками людей, не знающих Закона, пригвоздили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ко кресту и убили. \v 24 Но Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и освободил от мук смерти, потому что смерть не могла удержать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.R: Бог показал вам, что Иисус из Назарета пришёл от {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}. Бог совершал через Иисуса чудеса, удивительные дела и знаки, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был среди вас. Вы сами это знаете. \v 23 Бог задумал, что Иисус будет предан в ваши руки, и Бог знал, что это случится. Вы с помощью людей, которые не знали Божьего Закона, прибили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к кресту и убили. \v 24 Но Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} из мёртвых. Бог освободил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} от мук смерти, потому что смерть не могла удержать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

uk.L: Ісуса Назорея, мужа, засвідченого вам від Бога чудесами, і дивами, і знаками, які Бог учинив через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} посеред вас, як ви й самі знаєте, \v 23 цього [чоловіка], виданого за визначеним задумом і передбаченням Божим, ви вбили, прибивши [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до хреста] руками беззаконних, \v 24 якого Бог воскресив, розвʼязавши муки смерті, бо неможливо було, щоб вона {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} тримала.
uk.B: Ісус із Назарета був чоловіком, якого Бог засвідчив перед вами чудесами, дивами й знаками, що їх Бог учинив через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} серед вас, як ви й самі добре знаєте. \v 23 Бог визначив задум і знав його наперед: {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} було видано, а ви руками беззаконних прибили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до хреста і вбили. \v 24 Та Бог воскресив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} і звільнив від мук смерті, бо смерть ніяк не могла {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} втримати.
uk.R: Бог показав вам, що Ісус з Назарета прийшов від {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Бог робив через Ісуса чудеса, дива і знаки, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був серед вас. Ви самі це знаєте. \v 23 Божий задум був такий, що Ісуса буде видано вам, і Бог знав, що так станеться. Ви руками людей, які не знали Божого Закону, прибили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до хреста і вбили. \v 24 Але Бог воскресив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} з мертвих. Бог звільнив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} від мук смерті, бо смерть не могла втримати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.

ja.L: ナザレ人イエスは、神によってあなたがたに、力ある業と不思議な業としるしとをもって証明された人です。それらは、あなたがた自身が知っているとおり、神がこの方を通して、あなたがたの間で行われたものです。\v 23 この方が神の定められた計画と予知によって引き渡されると、あなたがたは不法な者たちの手によって[十字架に]釘付けにして、殺しました。\v 24 しかし神は、死の苦しみを解いて、この方を起こされました。この方が死に捕らえられたままでいることは、ありえなかったからです。
ja.B: ナザレのイエスは、神があなたがたの前で、この方がどういう方であるかをお示しになった人です。神は、この方を通して、力ある業と不思議な業としるしを、あなたがたの間で行われました。あなたがた自身がよく知っているとおりです。\v 23 神は計画を定め、前もってそれを知っておられました。イエスは引き渡され、あなたがたは律法を持たない者たちの手を借りて、イエスを十字架に釘付けにして殺したのです。\v 24 しかし神は、イエスを死の苦しみから解き放ち、復活させられました。死がイエスをとらえておくことなど、できなかったからです。
ja.R: 神は、ナザレから来たイエスが神のもとから来られた方であることを、みなさんに示されました。イエスがみなさんの間におられたとき、神はイエスを通して、奇跡や不思議なことやしるしを行われました。みなさん自身が知っているとおりです。\v 23 イエスがみなさんの手に渡されることは、神の計画でした。神はそうなることを前から知っておられたのです。みなさんは、神の律法を知らない人たちを使って、イエスを十字架に釘で打ちつけて殺しました。\v 24 しかし神は、イエスを死からよみがえらせられました。死の苦しみから解き放たれたのです。死は、イエスをとらえておくことができなかったからです。

decisions.choice: attested: shown and approved by God before you
decisions.reason: The word means to point out or show to be what one is. God's deeds through Jesus showed who he was.

decisions.choice: miracles, wonders and signs: three words for Jesus's deeds of power
decisions.reason: The first word means acts of power, the others what amazes and what points to God. "Wonders and signs" echo Joel (2:19).

decisions.choice: God's set plan, and the hearers' guilt, together
alternatives: God's plan makes them not to blame
they are to blame, and God only foresaw it
decisions.reason: Peter holds both: God had planned it (Luke 22:22; Acts 4:27-28), and they killed him (2:36, 3:13-15).

decisions.choice: lawless men: Gentiles, those without the law of Moses, that is, the Romans
decisions.reason: "Lawless" can mean "wicked", but a Jew used it of those outside the law of Moses (1 Corinthians 9:21). Roman soldiers carried out the crucifixion.

decisions.choice: the pains of death: death's grip, pictured as the pains of labor
decisions.reason: The word means the pains of childbirth. The Greek of Psalm 18:5-6 speaks of the "pains of death", where the Hebrew has "cords"; "loosed" suits the cords. Death is pictured as unable to keep him, as a woman cannot keep the child she bears.

decisions.choice: fastening: nailing him to the cross
decisions.reason: The verb means to fix or fasten; the cross is understood.

decisions.choice: the Nazarene (L); of Nazareth (B); from Nazareth (R)
decisions.reason: The word names Jesus by his hometown (Luke 4:16).

decisions.choice: the plan first, then what they did
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break Peter's long sentence and put God's plan first, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: acreditado
decisions.reason: Shown and approved by God before the hearers (meaning decision on attested); "acreditado" carries both the showing and the approval, where "aprobado" gives only the second.

decisions.choice: matendo ya nguvu (L, B); miujiza (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of the Greek word for deeds of power (as Acts 8:13): "matendo ya nguvu" keeps it apart from "maajabu" (wonders) and "ishara" (signs), the other two words in the list; Readable uses the everyday "miujiza" (miracles).

decisions.choice: maumivu ya mauti
decisions.reason: "Mauti" is death as a power that holds people, which suits the picture of death's grip (meaning decision on the pains of death); Readable uses the everyday "kifo".

decisions.choice: Peter speaks of Jesus as "Đức Giê-xu" and "Ngài", with the setting span, in his speeches
decisions.reason: Peter speaks as a believer, and in Vietnamese a believer speaking of Jesus uses the honorific forms, as the narrator does; "người ấy" is kept at Literal for the Greek "this one" in 2:23.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ không có luật pháp" (L, B); "những người không biết luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The lawless men are the Gentiles, the Romans, who were without the law of Moses (meaning decision); a word for wicked men would lose that.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks of Jesus with the honorific ("분", "넘겨지셨는데", "계실")
decisions.reason: Peter is Jesus's disciple and speaks of him with respect, as the disciples do in the Korean Luke 24:19. The crowd's own deed ("죽였습니다") takes no honorific.

decisions.choice: "나사렛 사람 예수" (L), "나사렛 예수" (B), "나사렛에서 오신 예수" (R); "능력 있는 일" (L, B), "기적" (R), "기사" (L) / "놀라운 일" (B, R), "표적"; "불법한 사람들" (L), "율법 없는 사람들" (B), "하나님의 율법을 모르는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The three words for Jesus's deeds are kept apart as in 2:19 and the Korean Luke 10:13. The lawless men are those without the law of Moses, the Romans (meaning decision), which Balanced and Readable make plain.

decisions.choice: "사망의 고통" (L), "죽음의 고통" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Death's grip is pictured as the pains of labor (meaning decision); Literal keeps "고통", the pain itself, with the older word "사망".

decisions.choice: [homens] sem lei (L); homens sem a Lei (B)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "sem lei" and "fora da lei" mean outlaws. The meaning note (m4) takes the word as those outside the law of Moses, the Romans, so Balanced adds the article and the capital: "sem a Lei". Literal keeps the bare Greek phrase; Readable says it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "यीशु नासरी" (L); "नासरत के यीशु" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 18:37: Literal keeps the Greek title, Balanced and Readable name the town.

decisions.choice: the apostles speak of Jesus with honorific forms ("उनके द्वारा", "वे पकड़वाए गए")
decisions.reason: Jesus's followers speak of him with respect, as the narrator does, also when they speak to those who killed him.

decisions.choice: Назорей (L); из Назарета (B, R)
decisions.reason: As settled in Luke, the Greek word Nazoraios is "Назорей" at Literal; Balanced and Readable name the town.

decisions.choice: беззаконные (L); люди, не знающие Закона (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means those without the Law of Moses, the Romans; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "Назорей" (L), "із Назарета" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek here is Nazōraios, so Literal uses "Назорей" and keeps "Назарянин" for Nazarēnos, as in the Gospels; Balanced and Readable name the town.

decisions.choice: "起こされた" (L); "復活させられた" (B); "よみがえらせられた" (R) for God raising Jesus, through Acts
